arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-membership.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch feat/membership-registry-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work"
cd "$work"
git --no-pager log -1 --format='MEMBERSHIP_COMMIT=%H'
git --no-pager diff --check HEAD
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; paths=[Path("scripts/member_groups.py"),Path("scripts/safe_runtime.py"),Path("scripts/leads_operational_report.py"),Path("scripts/deploy_project_only.py")]; [ast.parse(p.read_text()) for p in paths]; print("SYNTAX_CHECKS",len(paths))'
node --check ecosystem.config.js
echo MEMBERSHIP_REGISTRY_TESTS_PASS
